+from itertools import combinations

+def _quota_solver(capacity, tie):
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        if mandatory & blocked or len(mandatory) > k:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_value = None
+        best_ids = None
+        for subset in combinations(options, k):
+            ids = sorted(job["id"] for job in subset)
+            if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in subset:
+                group = job["group"]
+                counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            active = []
+            valid = True
+            for job in sorted(subset, key=lambda row: (row["start"], row["end"])):
+                active = [end for end in active if end > job["start"]]
+                if len(active) >= capacity:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                active.append(job["end"])
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and
+                     ((tie == "smallest" and ids < best_ids) or
+                      (tie == "largest" and ids > best_ids)))):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+    return solve
+
+
+def _build_component_06():
+    def rounded(n, mode):
+        q, r = divmod(n, 10000)
+        return q + (1 if mode == "half_up" and 2 * r >= 10000 else 0)
+
+    def solve(data):
+        cutoff = data.get("cutoff", 10**9)
+        winners = {}
+        for pos, event in enumerate(data["events"]):
+            seq = event.get("sequence", 0)
+            if seq > cutoff:
+                continue
+            eid = event.get("id", "anonymous:" + str(pos))
+            key = (seq, event.get("revision", 0), pos)
+            if eid not in winners or key > winners[eid][0]:
+                winners[eid] = (key, event)
+        balances = dict(data.get("opening", {}))
+        mode = data["rounding"]
+        for _, event in winners.values():
+            if event.get("void", False):
+                continue
+            raw = event["price"] * event.get("quantity", 1)
+            discount = min(10000, max(0, event.get("discount_bp", 0)))
+            net = rounded(raw * (10000 - discount), mode)
+            tax = rounded(raw * event.get("tax_bp", 0), mode)
+            amount = net + tax
+            if event.get("kind") == "refund":
+                amount = -amount
+            key = event.get("account", "default") + "|" + event.get("currency", "USD")
+            balances[key] = balances.get(key, 0) + amount
+        return {"balances": balances}
+    return solve
+
+
+def _build_component_07():
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        roots = data.get("roots", {})
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        rows = {name: {row["version"]: row for row in versions}
+                for name, versions in packages.items()}
+        choices = [[None] + sorted(rows[name]) for name in names]
+        best_vector = None
+        best = None
+
+        for assignment in __import__("itertools").product(*choices):
+            selected = dict(zip(names, assignment))
+            if any(selected[name] is None or
+                   not bounds[0] <= selected[name] <= bounds[1]
+                   for name, bounds in roots.items()):
+                continue
+            if any(selected[name] is not None and
+                   (selected[name] in blocked.get(name, []) or
+                    (name in pins and selected[name] != pins[name]))
+                   for name in names):
+                continue
+            edges = {name: [] for name in names if selected[name] is not None}
+            valid = True
+            for name, version in selected.items():
+                if version is None:
+                    continue
+                row = rows[name][version]
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    other_version = selected[other]
+                    if other_version is None or not dep["min"] <= other_version <= dep["max"]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    edges[name].append(other)
+                if not valid:
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            reachable = set()
+            stack = list(roots)
+            while stack:
+                name = stack.pop()
+                if name in reachable:
+                    continue
+                reachable.add(name)
+                stack.extend(edges.get(name, []))
+            installed = {name for name, version in selected.items() if version is not None}
+            if reachable != installed:
+                continue
+            finished, active = set(), set()
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in active:
+                    return False
+                if name in finished:
+                    return True
+                active.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(other) for other in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                active.remove(name)
+                finished.add(name)
+                return True
+            if not all(visit(name) for name in installed):
+                continue
+            vector = tuple(selected[name] if selected[name] is not None else -1
+                           for name in sorted(names, reverse=True))
+            if best_vector is None or vector > best_vector:
+                best_vector = vector
+                best = {name: version for name, version in selected.items()
+                        if version is not None}
+        if best is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best}
+    return solve
+
